name: Güzellik 020 — Müşteriler listesi A→Z
description: Demo Güzellik (020) Güzellik Merkezi → Müşteriler listesi açılır; yeni/iptal veya satır doğrulama.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Güzellik (020), pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Open the top shell module labeled Güzellik Merkezi
In the beauty sidebar under Operasyonlar, click Müşteriler
If a Yeni or add-client control is visible, open it then close with İptal or back without saving
Verify the Müşteriler client list screen is visible with a searchable list, cards, or empty-state — not a blank error page
